snippet.title: [Releases February 18] Menherarium PV
snippet.description:
♥ Releasing Wednesday, February 18, 2026 ♥
A deck-building roguelite where you wager blood in Chinchiro with an ultra-menhera girl (CV: Yuko Natsuyoshi) and aim to survive seven days — Menherarium.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394770/_/

※ A brand-new demo will be available on Monday, February 9. Be sure to check it out!

If you’re not familiar with Chinchiro, let Menhera-chan teach you here:
https://youtu.be/jdHTsKGwdx8

On Wednesday, February 18, be sure to spend some time playing with Menhera-chan.

#Phoenixx
